entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF88602.
Thank you, Mark. Pulling that up now... I see an order for a Pro-Series Jersey. Is that the item you're calling about?
Yes. The jersey.
Okay. And what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size.
I see. And when you say wrong size, could you be more specific? Is it too large or too small?
It's too tight. Way too tight in the shoulders.
Alright, thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 35 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Fine.

Okay, thank you for your patience. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the window. We can definitely process this for you. Would you like a refund, or would you prefer an exchange for the next size up?
Whatever. Just send the bigger one. I guess I'll do the exchange.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file now. Just print that out, attach it to the package with the original jersey, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size.
Got the email. About time something worked.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mark?
No. I'm done.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you enjoy the new jersey when it arrives. Have a great day.
